what: The commenter says digital planners become a burden more than a pleasure and that they find it easier to keep up with iCalendar, Apple Notes, and Numbers.
verbatim_snippet: "I am feeling you and struggle with the same issues… I love the planner and starting to create my own, but I have a busy life and done always have the time to sit down with my iPad…. I find it easier to keep up with my iCalender/ Apple Notes/ and Numbers (excel)…. I want to use the digital planners…. But it becomes a burden more than a pleasure"
